title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series 'One-of-a-Kind Romance' to Debut in 2nd Half of 2026
content: Production company Corpus Korea confirmed on June 2 that the One-of-a-Kind Romance webtoon is getting a live-action adaptation that will premiere in the second half of the year on TVING, with additional distribution on Viu in Hong Kong and ABEMA in Japan.
author: ANN

title: 'Draw This, Then Die!' Anime's 2nd Promo Video Reveals Ending Song
content: The official website for the television anime of Minoru Toyoda 's Draw This, Then Die! ( Kore Kaite Shine ) manga started streaming the anime's second promotional video on Monday, which reveals and previews the ending theme song "Conifer" by Regal Lily . The band specifically wrote the song for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Tamamori's Fantasies Never Stop Manga's Tatsuwaipu Launches New Series
content: Kodansha 's YanMaga Web platform announced on June 1 that Tamamori's Fantasies Never Stop! creator Tatsuwaipu will launch a new series titled Deriheru Yondara Moto Dōkyūsei ga Kita (When I Called an Escort Service, My Former Classmate Came) on the platform on June 13. The manga will update on Saturdays.
author: ANN

title: Chronoscript: The Endless End Action Game Launches This Fall
content: DeskWorks announced during the "Future Games Show: Summer Showcase" livestream on Saturday that Chronoscript: The Endless End , its new action-adventure game , will launch for the PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam in fall 2026. A thousand year long story that refuses to end.
author: ANN

title: Blue Exorcist Manga Returns on July 3
content: The July issue of Shueisha 's Jump SQ. magazine announced on Thursday that Kazue Katō 's Blue Exorcist manga will resume serialization in the next issue on July 3. Katō also reported on Thursday that she has started drawing chapter 167 (after mistakenly saying it was chapter "178").
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Acclaimed Fantasy Creator Confirms New Release Ahead of Season 2
content: Kusanagi Mizuho’s beloved Yona of the Dawn manga returns with new side stories in the latest issue of Hakusensha’s Hana to Yume magazine. 16 years after the manga’s debut, the epic journey of Yona and her friends reached its bittersweet conclusion in December 2025.
author: ComicBook

title: New Fairy Tail Manga Miniseries Is Titled Fairy Tail Re:Fantasia
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for manga creator Hiro Mashima reported on Sunday that his new Fairy Tail manga miniseries is titled Fairy Tail Re:Fantasia . The miniseries will launch in this year's 35th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine , which will ship on July 29.
author: ANN

title: 5 Best Anime You Probably First Watched on Fox Kids
content: There’s no shortage of places to discover anime in the 2020s, and viewers of all ages can find something to watch on platforms like Crunchyroll and Netflix. In the late ’90s and early 2000s, however, many kids relied on programming blocks like Fox Kids, Toonami, and Kids’ WB to discover new series within the medium.
author: ComicBook

title: Attack on Titan Confirms an Exciting Project With a New Trailer
content: Attack on Titan is an acclaimed series written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama. Produced by WIT Studio, the anime reached new heights of popularity in 2013. The animation studio released the first three seasons before giving up on the series since it couldn’t meet the tight deadline after the manga’s finale.
author: ComicBook

title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Game Announced
content: Koei Tecmo revealed during the "Xbox Games Showcase 2026" livestream on Sunday Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember , the sequel to Team Ninja's 2023 game Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty . The game will debut for Xbox series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox PC (and Xbox Cloud), and PC via Steam in early 2027.
author: ANN
